inputs.label: Half-Life (steam_legacy build)
inputs.help: In Steam, open Half-Life > Properties > Betas and select steam_legacy (Pre-25th Anniversary Build). Let it update, then continue. Half-Life: Source does not work.

inputs.label: Opposing Force (optional)
inputs.help: The gearbox folder of the same steam_legacy Half-Life install.

inputs.label: Blue Shift (optional)
inputs.help: The bshift folder of the same steam_legacy Half-Life install.

steps.why: The first launch creates the /sdcard/xash/ folder tree.

steps.text: Restart the headset, then open Lambda1VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: Guided because the user must switch Steam to the steam_legacy beta first; the current public build is reported broken for Lambda1VR (hl-paker README, 2025-04-04; r/TeamBeef pinned post). The Steam install has no WON pak0.pak, so detect uses liblist.gam. Copying the whole valve folder takes a long time. Optional HD models (valve_hd) are not modelled; the guide gives no target for them. Opposing Force and Blue Shift have their own Steam app IDs (50, 130) but their folders live in the Half-Life install, so appId is 70.
